title: The Old Wars: A First Blooding

texts.details:
You hit the dummy well enough. The dummy does not hit back, and it does not have friends.

Before I teach you another thing, I want to know what you do when something is trying to kill you. The Riverpaw gnolls are in the woods around this town. Take six of their outrunners. Fight them one at a time if you can, and learn what happens when you cannot.

There is one among them the farmers call Rukk Splitear. He is bigger than the rest and he likes it. Bring him down, $N. Then we will talk about war.
texts.objectives: Kill 6 Riverpaw Outrunners and then Rukk Splitear, in the woods near Goldshire. Return to your trainer when it is done.
texts.progress: Keep your feet under you. A warrior who falls over is a meal.
texts.completion:
Rukk is dead? Good. You are still standing, which is the first test and the only one that counts.

Now listen. Everything you will ever do with a blade was learned by someone, in one of the wars this world has had. First, Second, Third: we number them, as though that made them tidy. A warrior who does not know those wars is only someone with a sharp piece of iron.

So that is how I will have you taught. One war at a time, by those who fought it. Take your pick of these. When you have twenty seasons of sense, go to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire. He was there for the first.

idea: The Old Wars, level 10 (Alliance): the warrior's first real fight, against one the trainer names. Invented: Rukk Splitear.
